title: Another Week of Working on Overdrive! Improved Animations, Combat, UI, and More!
author: ProfMags
selftext:
Hello! Just wanted to share another update on my game, Overdrive! It's been about a week since my first post, and I've made quite a few improvements since then.

I've been working a lot on the animations recently. They're still far from perfect, but I think they're a huge improvement over what they were before. I've also completely overhauled the UI, improved the HUD, and added better ragdoll physics when ramming into enemies.

One of the bigger additions is the new Overdrive ability. Once activated, the player gets access to a set of powerful melee weapons for 15 seconds that deal critical damage. The Overdrive meter charges by consistently landing accurate shots on enemies, rewarding players for good aim.

I've been using Opus 5.5 to help with assets and VFX, which has been a huge help throughout development.

There's still a ton of work left to do, but I'm pretty happy with how things are coming along! I'd love to hear what you guys think of the improvements and how the game is looking so far. Any feedback or suggestions are appreciated! :)

comments.author: Barbarossa31
comments.body:
This looks really promising! Some thoughts from me are ok? 

1. Animation need a bit more work, its really fast and a bit too stiff even for a robot, its a bit hard to explain for me, but the robot feels too light weight, he needs wheight in the walk animation, a bit slower and more heavy and the footstep sound needs to be deeper, an maybe a little bit of shake while walking, the backward is also too fast, that looks cheap. 
2. His legs are spread too wide, it looks like he has really big balls 🤣, give his body a bit more motion and a tighter leg stand. 
3.  Sounds needs work, the shooting sound is like a empty can of beans, the juice is missing.
4. Background music style for me is... idk... nah but thats your taste 😅

But it looks good, keep up the work and you can build a game that isnt slop.
